shortDescription: Create, update, or delete VAST UserQuota resources

options.name: grace_period
options.description:
Quota enforcement grace period. An alarm is triggered and write operations are blocked if storage usage continues
to exceed the soft limit for the grace period. Format: [DD] [HH:[MM:]]s

options.name: hard_limit
options.description: Storage usage limit beyond which no writes will be allowed.

options.name: hard_limit_inodes
options.description:
Number of directories and unique files under the path beyond which no writes will be allowed. A file with
multiple hardlinks is counted only once.

options.name: id
options.description: Resource ID for direct lookup. Mutually exclusive with name-based identification.

options.name: identifier_type
options.description: Set to True for a group. Set to false for a user.

options.name: is_group
options.description: Set to True for a group. Set to false for a user.

options.name: name
options.description: A user name or group name.

options.name: quota_group_id
options.description: The ID of the quota group to which the user/group quota should be added. Requires VMS 5.5 or later.

options.name: quota_id
options.description: The ID of the quota to which the user/group quota should be added.

options.name: soft_limit
options.description: Storage usage limit at which warnings of exceeding the quota are issued.

options.name: soft_limit_inodes
options.description:
Number of directories and unique files under the path at which warnings of exceeding the quota will be issued. A
file with multiple hardlinks is counted only once.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for async operations to complete.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for async operations.
